description: Serializes EmailTemplateDocument to and from JSON. Block polymorphism uses the type discriminator declared on EmailBlockBase. Unknown properties are ignored (forward compatibility); unknown block types and malformed JSON surface as EmailTemplateSerializationException.

members.name: CloneBlock
members.description: Creates an independent deep copy of a single block (same identifiers).

members.name: Serialize
members.description: Serializes a document to a compact JSON string.

members.name: Options
members.description: Gets the canonical serialization options used for documents, blocks and cloning.
